hook: ISO 11228-3 is the global ergonomic standard for preventing repetitive upper limb injuries at work.

sections.voiceover: ISO 11228-3 is the global ergonomic standard for preventing repetitive upper limb injuries at work.

In May 2026, the International Organization for Standardization published the 2nd edition of ISO 11228-3. Does the new ISO 11228-3:2026 standard officially replace the withdrawn 2007 version for your workplace?
Yes, the new ISO 11228-3:2026 standard officially supersedes the withdrawn 2007 version for all workplaces.
The British Standards Institution implemented this 2nd edition through its Technical Committee PH/9/ -/4.
